title: Level1Answer
description: A fast, typed level-1 answer (ADR-0015). It is an attributed engine estimate ('<engine> estimates 0.82 for X'), never a verdict: it does not count as a decision, does not trigger rules and does not enter statistics. `choice` is one of `options`. World changes it implies arrive as proposals by agent:<engine>.

engine.description: Engine name, e.g. local-rules, a local model, or the Jev connector.

options.description: The closed set of options (the enum of the output schema).

confidence.description: The engine's own confidence for `choice`, shown attributed to the engine. Not an ICD 203 estimate.

inputs.description: Cards and rules the engine received (after the disclosure gate).

request.title: Level1Request
request.description: What a ModelConnector receives for a level-1 decision: the question, the closed options, and gate-cleared inputs.
